items.title: Determinantal formulas for equivariant K-theoretic double k-Schur functions of k-small partitions
items.author: Takeshi Ikeda; Shinsuke Iwao; Satoshi Naito; Kohei Yamaguchi
items.source_version: Official SIGMA 22 (2026), 065; publisher native TeX retrieved 2026-10-13; arXiv:2505.02941
items.difficulty_reason: The author gives a uniform block determinant for every k-small partition, with coefficient-dependent symmetric-function entries and an equivariant denominator. The full column-case computation, general matrix reduction and automorphism machinery are retained. This explicit formula is a distinct target from the quantum-affine Schubert map identification; the companion determinant and rectangle support are not new counted items.

proof_spans.label: complete author examples, intermediate matrix identities, column case and general determinant proof

contexts.label: full Toda, centralizer, automorphism, Grothendieck and determinant setup
full companion determinant formula, rectangle identities and non-adjacent operator calculations
